failed_witness: The host policy rejected recursive removal of the three exact verified partial transaction paths before any deletion.
passing_witness: The partial transaction remains isolated under its original label and a distinct recovery label prevents reuse or collision.
recovery: Do not weaken the host guard; retain and mark the partial transaction, then use a fresh recovery-labelled transaction.
recurrence_guard: Prefer quarantine and additive recovery when an exact destructive rollback is unavailable.
rollback: No deletion occurred and no unrelated path was touched.
sibling_recommendation: A blocked rollback is a retained operational failure, not permission to use another shell or weaken protection.
